newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai rubber prices, supplies higher at Hatyai.
newsitem.headline: Thai rubber prices, supplies higher at Hatyai.

text.p: Thai rubber prices and supplies were both higher at the Hatyai rubber auction in southern Thailand for the week ending on August 30, auction officials said on Friday.
Turnover at the state-run auction was 381.7 tonnes compared with 329.3 tonnes for the week ending on August 23.
Prices were on average 0.91 baht/kg higher than the previous week, with third grade unsmoked sheet sold at 26.74-28.00 baht/kg compared with 26.45-26.69 baht/kg the previous week.
